id.description: Unique id (m1, m2…): what feedback targets.

to.description: The receiving participant id; equal to from for a self-call.

label.description: The text on the arrow; for a sub-flow block, the sub-flow's name.

style.description: solid (a call, default) or dashed (a reply).

ref.description: A sub-flow block: the key of another chart in the charts dataset. Drawn as a block spanning from..to with an open icon; click it to open that chart.

returns.description: A sub-flow block's output, drawn as a dashed arrow from `to` back into `from` right after the block.
